title: Open Repair Data Standard
summary: The Open Repair Data Standard is an initiative by the Open Repair Alliance to create a unified format for sharing repair data, documentation, and spare parts information across the repair community ecosystem.
problem_solved: Enables interoperability and standardized data sharing among disparate repair databases, tools, and community initiatives.
why_valuable: Supports the right-to-repair movement by creating shared infrastructure that makes repair information more accessible, discoverable, and reusable across platforms.
